title: Islamic fashion gains popularity – B1+ English Listening Test

seo.title: Islamic fashion gains popularity – B1+ English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: B1-B2 listening test. Advanced listening practice. Fashion. Transcription included. Watch the video and answer the multiple-choice questions.

parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video about Islamic fashion, also called ‘modest fashion’. For questions 1 to 6, choose the correct option. You can see the transcription after submitting your answers.

See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: Istanbul has turned into a Mecca for Islamic fashion due to ...

choices.html: the diversity of styles and cheap prices.
the wide range of brands that sell their products there.
increased their sales after France banned the burkini.
is the second biggest Islamic fashion website in Europe.

questions.prompt: Franka says that Islamic fashion is becoming more popular ...
Franka prefers to use the term ‘modest fashion’ instead of ‘Islamic fashion’ because ...

choices.html: the term ‘Islamic’ is not so good for marketing.
‘modest’ reflects their religious ideas about fashion better.
not only Muslim companies make this type of fashion.
want to respond to the needs of traditional conservative women.
want to be absorbed by the general fashion industry.
